explanation: Fifteen compiler trials produced no exact match. The best aztec36 candidate, no-parse-clear.c, compiles to 656 bytes against the 622-byte target and its isolated owned-data check is BLOCKED. The zero-argument F_h00_463E variant independently matched the 38-byte literal-tail hash, but comparison stopped at an ambiguous PC-relative instruction at +0xEA. Stride and local-layout diagnostics remained unmeasurable because the candidate data boundary could not be aligned.
